records.title: Application is the untouched default template
records.symptom: Verification expected a materials page, a 资料助手 AI employee, business collections and two sample accounts; the repo only had Home, the framework-default atlas employee, no business tables and no accounts. /main/materials redirected to /main, aiConversations:list was empty and no LLM model was configured.
records.rootCause: The application had never been implemented. The reported defects were the template's empty starting state, not a regression in an existing feature.
records.resolution: Implemented the whole read-only internal-materials feature in application-owned source: migration + seeds for a `materials` collection and two Permission Sets, an authorization model (composite `materials.directory`, `materials.visible` record access), server routes under `/api/materials` with per-route authentication and authorization, a read-only `lookup-materials` AI tool and `materials-assistant` employee, three client pages (`/materials`, `/materials-admin`, `/materials-assistant`), sample-account provisioning, locales and README documentation.
records.cost: high — full feature build across database, server, client and AI wiring

records.title: Record-access scope rejected because of a qualified collection name
records.symptom: Repository reads failed with `"main.materials" does not match "materials"` when the `materials.visible` scope was applied.
records.rootCause: The scope AST used the two-part connection-qualified id while the Repository was created with the logical collection name, and `normalizeScalarFilter` requires `ast.collection` to equal `repository.collection.name`.
records.resolution: Used the logical name `materials` for the scope and for the Repository, keeping `MATERIALS_COLLECTION_ID` only for code that must name the connection explicitly.
records.cost: medium — traced through the authorization/resolver source

records.title: Update permission rejected the primary key
records.symptom: PATCH /api/materials/:id failed with `Field "id" is not a writable scalar field`.
records.rootCause: The update grant used the wildcard `'*'`, and `resolveActionFields` expands `'*'` to every collection field including the generated `id`.
records.resolution: Declared the update fields explicitly as `['title','content','updatedAt']`; `create('*')` and `read('*')` remain fine.

records.title: Boolean field rejected the equality operator
records.symptom: Reads failed with `Operator "$eq" is not supported for Field "confidential" of type "boolean"`.
records.rootCause: The boolean operator set in the repository only allows `$isTruly`, `$isFalsy`, `$empty` and `$notEmpty`.

records.title: Standalone test seed loader could not resolve app source imports
records.symptom: 16 tests failed with `PermissionSetNotFoundError: Unknown Permission Set: materials-manager` (and `Cannot find module '.../materials-permission-sets.js'`) from `MaterialsProvider.boot`.
records.rootCause: The standalone server loads migrations and seeds through `@nocobase/db`'s native task loader, which calls a plain `import(pathToFileURL(file))` and does not remap relative `.js` specifiers to `.ts`. `pnpm dev` registered `tsx` so the seed worked there, but the vitest standalone path loaded the `.ts` seed with Node's native type stripping, which does not rewrite `.js` to `.ts`. The permission-set seed therefore never ran and the subsequent assignment threw.
records.resolution: Used `.ts` import specifiers through the native-import chain (`seed -> database/seed-data/... -> server/materials/resources.ts -> ./constants.ts`). `allowImportingTsExtensions` and `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` are enabled for the server tsconfig, so `pnpm build` rewrites them back to `.js`; verified that `dist/database/seed-data/materials-permission-sets.js` and `dist/database/main/seeds/202609290003_materials_permission_sets.js` are emitted with working `.js` imports.

records.title: Application provider assumed plugin services during boot
records.symptom: The isolated `registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime` test failed with `Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered`.
records.rootCause: `MaterialsProvider.boot` resolved the authorization service unconditionally, but that test mounts `appRuntime.serviceProviders` without the authorization plugin and with its own routes.
records.resolution: Resolved `authorizationToken` and `userAdministrationServiceToken` with `resolveIfCreated` and skipped the corresponding work when absent. Added an existence check before `permissionSets.assign`, so a boot that runs before the permission-set seed creates the accounts without failing.

records.title: Whole test suite and deployment build are green
records.symptom: After the fixes, `npx vitest run` reported 325/325 passing, and the three tsconfig typechecks, targeted ESLint/Prettier, and `pnpm build` all succeeded.
records.resolution: Live curl verification against `pnpm dev` confirmed: anonymous 401; colleague lists only A/B; colleague reads C as 404; colleague writes as 403; supervisor lists and edits all three; `aiEmployees:listByUser` returns `materials-assistant` with the `lookup-materials` tool. `pnpm lint` / `pnpm format:check` still fail only on pre-existing `.github/` factory control files, which are out of scope and intentionally untouched.

improvements.title: Native DB task loader should remap relative `.js` specifiers to `.ts`
improvements.detail: `@nocobase/db`'s task loader uses a bare `import(pathToFileURL(file))`. In `pnpm dev` `app-cli` registers `tsx`, so app-owned seeds and migrations that import other application TypeScript via the conventional `.js` specifiers load fine; in a standalone/vitest process without `tsx`, the same files fail with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for nested imports. The workaround is to write `.ts` specifiers in that import chain, which works because the server tsconfig enables `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions`.
improvements.suggestedChange: Either make the loader rewrite relative `.js` specifiers to an existing `.ts` file (matching tsx), or document in the application development Skill that any seed or migration which imports application source must use explicit `.ts` specifiers so it loads under both tsx and plain Node type stripping.

improvements.title: Application providers that depend on plugin services need an optional-resolution contract
improvements.detail: The template's own `registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime` test mounts the application's service providers without the plugin set, so any provider that unconditionally resolves a plugin-owned service fails boot. Providers currently have to know to call `resolveIfCreated` and tolerate absence.
improvements.suggestedChange: Publish this expectation in the provider documentation/example (or provide a declarative `requires` list so the registry can skip a provider whose dependencies are absent), instead of leaving each provider author to rediscover it from a failing test.

improvements.title: Sanitized task metadata removed the sample-account credentials
improvements.detail: The specification requires two isolated test accounts but the repair prompt deliberately omitted their credentials, so the implementation could only choose its own and document them in the README. A browser acceptance agent cannot know them unless it reads that documentation.
improvements.suggestedChange: State in the repair prompt that the agent must provision and document the required sample accounts when the credentials are not supplied, or allow the acceptance harness to read the application's own documented accounts.

findings.title: 授权 scope 与默认连接 Repository 的集合命名口径不一致，记录范围查询以不透明 500 暴露
findings.detail: 应用按多连接寻址用限定名 main.materials 定义记录范围时，授权侧 collectionResolver 接受该限定名，Authorizer 以 resourceId 生成 scopeAst，Scope AST 的 collection 记为 main.materials；而默认连接上绑定的 Repository 逻辑名为 materials，normalizeScalarFilter 要求 ast.collection === collection.name，遂抛 INVALID_FILTER，HTTP 层呈现为 500。授权侧与数据层对同一集合存在两套命名口径。
findings.impact: 按指引/仓库使用限定名的实现会得到一个无定位信息的 500；本应用改用逻辑名 materials 绕过，但框架侧未修复，后续使用限定名仍会踩坑。
findings.suggestedChange: 让授权侧 scope 使用与 Repository 一致的逻辑集合名，或在 db 校验失败时给出包含命名不一致的明确错误；并在指引中写明 scope 与 Repository 必须共用逻辑集合名。

diagnosis.trigger: 记录范围 scope 的集合名（main.materials）与默认连接 Repository 的集合名（materials）不一致

diagnosis.actual: normalizeScalarFilter 抛 INVALID_FILTER，HTTP 层呈现为不透明 500
diagnosis.workaround: 把 scope 与 Repository 统一到逻辑名 materials（应用已如此处理）
diagnosis.acceptance: 普通同事列表按范围返回 A/B 且不出现 500；命名不一致时错误信息可直接定位

Define record access with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register it with `authz.recordAccess.define(access)`. Use `.collections(...names)` for applicability (`'*'` for every collection), `.params

(schema)` for typed parameters and `.resolver(fn)` for evaluation. The resolver receives `{ principal, collection, action, params }` and no database objects; it returns `true`, `false`, a filter built with `condition(...)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server`, or a `FilterAst` built with `buildFilter` from `@nocobase/repository-input`, which the database adapter validates and compiles. Grants and rules never store resolver functions: `.options(...)`, `.default(...)`, relation `.recordAccess(...)` and `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)` store keys.
